definitions.explanation: A component kept in stock or ordered to replace a worn, broken, or defective part in a machine, device, or vehicle.

examples.japanese: {交換|こうかん}{部品|ぶひん}を{注文|ちゅうもん}する。
この{機種|きしゅ}の{交換|こうかん}{部品|ぶひん}はもう{手|て}に{入|はい}らない。
examples.english: Replacement parts for this model are no longer available.

examples.japanese: {修理|しゅうり}には{交換|こうかん}{部品|ぶひん}の{費用|ひよう}と{工賃|こうちん}が{別途|べっと}かかります。
examples.english: The repair will incur separate costs for the replacement part and labor.

notes:
A compound of {交換|こうかん} (exchange; replacement) and {部品|ぶひん} (parts; components). Used in maintenance, repair, and manufacturing contexts. Essential vocabulary when dealing with car maintenance, appliance repair, or technical support in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {交換|こうかん}{部品|ぶひん}を{取|と}り{寄|よ}せる: to order a replacement part
- {交換|こうかん}{部品|ぶひん}の{在庫|ざいこ}: replacement parts inventory
- {純正|じゅんせい}{交換|こうかん}{部品|ぶひん}: genuine replacement parts
- {交換|こうかん}{部品|ぶひん}{代|だい}: cost of replacement parts

SIMILAR WORDS:
- スペアパーツ: spare parts — loanword, often used in automotive contexts
- {予備|よび}{部品|ぶひん}: spare parts — parts kept in reserve as backup
- {消耗品|しょうもうひん}: consumable parts — parts designed to be replaced regularly through normal use
